intel.title: [CISA KEV] Broadcom VMware ESX - Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-41709
廠商: Broadcom
產品: VMware ESX
漏洞名稱: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
說明: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-11
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 已將 CVE-2026-41709 列入已知利用漏洞，該漏洞為 VMware ESX 日誌記錄不足問題，擁有管理員權限的威脅者可執行未被記錄的操作。公司內部正使用 VMware ESXi 虛擬化平台，需關注權限控管與修補進度。
analysis.recommendation: 請負責部門（RR40）儘速參照 Broadcom 官方安全修補公告更新 VMware ESXi 版本；在完成升級前，應嚴格限制管理員權限存取，並加強網路邊界與系統稽核監控。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Linux Kernel - Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-46300
廠商: Linux
產品: Kernel
漏洞名稱: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
說明: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-31
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Linux Kernel 存在變數未初始化漏洞（CVE-2026-46300），可導致 socket 緩衝區處理解析異常並經由 ESP 輸入處理解密共享片段。該漏洞已遭活躍利用（CISA KEV），可與其他漏洞鏈結植入 PHP webshell 並以 root 權限執行命令。由於公司多項核心資產採用 Linux 作業系統與雲端容器環境，遭攻擊風險極高。
analysis.recommendation:
1. 針對內部 Linux Ubuntu 伺服器及 AWS EC2 / EKS 節點主機，依廠商指示儘速修補並更新 Linux Kernel 至最新修補版本。
2. 若雲端或實體主機無法立即重啟更新，應依 CISA BOD 26-04 網際網路暴露評估指引實施存取控制與網路微隔離緩解措施。
3. 加強系統日誌監控，檢查是否有異常之 PHP webshell 植入或非預期的 root 命令執行跡象。
